Bridie is elegant but flirty. Designed in floaty chiffon, this hot pink floral maxi dress features a high boat neck and long fluted sheer sleeves. The fully lined top balances the lightness of the sleeve, whilst the skirt falls into a tiered frill hem for soft volume and movement. Bridie is made for occasions that call for understated impact.

Model size: UK 8/US 4/EU 36
Model height: 5'9.5 / 176cm
